description: A faithful mechanical baker cat Codex pet with a tall white chef hat, brass bell collar, warm brass joints, gray-beige body, and a beloved golden bread companion.

idle.notes: Quiet seated bakery idle on the loaf with tiny blink, breathing, and subtle hat and bell motion.

walk.notes: True directional walk rows with short light steps and bread kept visible for movement and drag-facing behavior.

curious.notes: Warm focused bread-inspection loop with small head tilts and attentive eyes.

happy.notes: Restrained satisfied baker mood with proud little expression changes and subtle bell sway.

sleep.notes: Safe curled loaf-rest with closed eyes while the chef hat and bell stay readable.

knead.notes: In-place bakery work loop with alternating front-paw kneading on the loaf.

jump.notes: Small buoyant hop that preserves Bun's compact proportions, bread, hat, and bell.

yawn.notes: Cozy tired yawn cycle after work, repurposing the spare row without any failure effects.

drag.notes: Directional drag uses the true-facing walk rows generated independently for left and right.

bake.notes: No separate bake row fit in the fixed atlas after prioritizing core states. The closest mood proxy is the satisfied happy row, and bread remains visible across the pet.

push.notes: No separate push-cart row fit in the fixed atlas. The closest proxy is the directional bread-carrying walk pair.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the true left-facing walk row
right drag uses the true right-facing walk row
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
head, eyes, body, chef hat, bell, tail, and bread all stay directionally unified in both walk rows
